description: SYNTHETIC quickstart set. Real OrderBot runs (live Bedrock, frozen) over a generated order book; gold labels derived from the written return policy by a fixed rule, not by a human. Two hunted rounds, each its own locked test, scoped by the `label_round` taxonomy-cell key. Rebuild with `python -m corpus.generate.quickstart_set build`.
policy: Final-sale items are never refundable. Any other item is refundable if it was delivered no more than its return_window_days ago. An item the customer reports as damaged, broken, defective or not working is refundable up to 90 days after delivery, even outside its return window.
